title: If Fabinho moves to a new club during the 2026 summer transfer window, which club will he join?
background: Brazilian midfielder Fabinho joined Al-Ittihad in 2023 after spending five years at Liverpool. This question is conditional on him making a permanent move to another club.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official club announcements or regulatory filings confirming Fabinho’s signing. 
  Resolution Rule : Resolve to the first new club officially confirmed as signing Fabinho on a permanent contract between June 1 and September 30, 2026, regardless of his previous contractual status. Loans do not qualify. If no qualifying signing is announced during this period, the question is void. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the destination club.
